name: Stackoulder
look: a round grey boulder with big stern eyes and stubby feet, balancing a tower of flat stones on its head and an olive pebble on the flat stone it holds out like a tray
entry: It never drops the stones it balances, not even in battle. Its sense of balance is so fine that it can feel an earthquake coming a whole day before it strikes.
how: Wild: uncommon on mountains, hills and highlands.
